The '''Murakam system''' was a part of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] known as [[Murakami orchid]].<ref name="RedHarvest" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Murakam [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
